name: settings-page
title: Settings Page
description: An account settings screen laid out as a bordered three-column grid: profile fields with an avatar, notification switches, appearance and language options, security actions and a danger zone, with Cancel and Save at the bottom.
use: A product needs one scannable account screen covering profile, notifications, appearance and security.
avoid: It hardcodes its own section content and sample user, so each card must be edited or replaced to match real fields.
a11y: Fields are properly labelled and reachable by keyboard; the theme control and switches rely on the imported parts for rings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black page fills with a fine grid of dark cards separated by single-pixel borders. Each card has a bold heading and grey helper line, then rows of labels, inputs, switches or outline buttons; the footer row holds a note beside Cancel and Save buttons.
behaves: The page scrolls vertically through profile, notification, appearance, security and danger sections. Rows respond to input: text fields edit in place, switches flip, the theme control picks one of three, and the danger zone ends in a red Delete button.
customise: SettingsPage takes no props: section titles, field labels and the sample user are written inside, so you edit the file or compose the exported sections with your own fields.
weight: light: Plain form markup with no animation loop; the cost is the many imported controls.
